metric.item_credit: correct proposition, exact locator, statement-versus-interpretation label, and calculation when required

expected_relationships.proposition: Treatment stores locator-bearing candidate claims, contradiction status, and an unresolved-question queue while control has no persistent ledger.
The registered design uses 48 packs, three seeds per pack, and at most four treatment evidence passes.
The preregistered primary endpoint is supported-claim recall with treatment 0.84 and control 0.73.
The absolute primary-endpoint difference is 0.11 in favor of treatment.
Treatment precision is 0.01 lower than control precision.
Treatment median latency is approximately 1.561 times control latency.
The authors support further evaluation but do not claim general superiority outside registered synthetic tasks.
The unweighted mean domain-level recall difference is 0.11.
The table reports 17 fewer missed cross-source links for treatment.
Two truncated-fixture control attempts were excluded before scoring and replaced under the registered policy.
Treatment pack-level standard deviation is approximately 1.079 times control.
Open-world performance was not measured, so the role-relevant conclusion is an evaluation-design signal rather than proof of live-research superiority.
